subject: Urban Planning
title: Fare-Free Transit: Should Buses Be Free?
description: A quick win: understand Fare-Free Transit: Should Buses Be Free?.

hook.text: Luxembourg made all public transit free in 2020. Ridership went up. Traffic didn't go down.

buildup.text: Fare collection is expensive — ticket machines, enforcement, and fare gates can cost more than the fares collect.

discovery.text: Kansas City went fare-free and ridership jumped 30%. Boarding sped up without fare tapping.

twist.text: Critics say free transit attracts riders who would have walked — it doesn't pull drivers out of cars.

climax.text: Over 100 cities worldwide now offer fare-free transit. The debate is shifting from 'if' to 'how.'

punchline.text: Collecting fares sometimes costs more than the fares themselves.

quiz.question: What country made all public transit free in 2020?
